topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: When I finally tracked down my childhood best friend, I expected a warm reunion, a flood of memories. Instead, there was a look in their eyes that suggested they were meeting me for the first time. I started sharing stories from our youth, hoping to spark some recognition, but their polite nods and vague smiles cut deep. I kept slipping in more details, almost desperately, wondering if I had been the one to drift away first, if I hadn’t kept in touch enough. The more I spoke, the more I felt the weight of the years that had passed, and the silence that had grown between us.
